packs.name: Mountains
packs.description: Layered ridgelines fading into dithered haze, under a sun or a moon

packs.name: Tides
packs.description: Wave-line seas under a sun or a moon, drawn as a moiré-safe line field

packs.name: Constellations
packs.description: Star-atlas plates of Orion, the Plough, Cassiopeia, Cygnus and Scorpius

packs.name: Botanica
packs.description: Ferns, bushes and grasses grown from L-systems, drawn as botanical plates

packs.name: Deco
packs.description: Art-deco sunbursts, fans, chevrons and stepped frames around a clock plaque

packs.name: Typographic
packs.description: Book pages in Literata: drop caps, public-domain quotations and hairline rules

packs.name: Cities
packs.description: Night skylines with lit windows, a harbour bridge, old-town spires and rain

packs.name: Moons
packs.description: Lunar phases with stippled craters and dithered maria

packs.name: Labyrinths
packs.description: Perfect mazes on square, polar and hex grids, and the classical seven-circuit labyrinth

packs.name: Woodcut
packs.description: Block-print landscapes: engraved hills, gouged skies and a rough border
